name: Shard of Water
summary: Along the Barrens coast, Islen Waterseer receives the Shard of Water from a shaman who has faced corruption.

sections.title: Token of Elemental Purity
sections.body: Shamans must understand balance, life, and preservation to master water. In the Call of Water, they travel to corrupted springs, even crossing the sea to blighted Silverpine Forest. After purifying the tainted waters, a shaman receives the Shard of Water. Returning the crystal token to Islen Waterseer on the rocky Barrens shore proves the initiate's worth and provides the final key to forge a Water Totem.

faq.q: What is the Shard of Water used for?
aliases: what does shard of water do
why do i have shard of water
faq.answer: You bring the shard to Islen Waterseer on the Barrens' eastern shore as proof of your trial. Presenting it completes your communion with water and earns you a Water Totem.

aliases: where to turn in shard of water
faq.answer: Islen Waterseer, a shaman in a hut south of Ratchet along the Merchant Coast, asks for the shard to confirm you purified tainted water.

faq.q: Why was the trial set as far away as Silverpine?
faq.answer: Water means healing and preservation, while corruption halts life. Silverpine's tainted waters test whether you can restore elemental harmony amid deep decay.

angles.text: As a shaman, obtaining the shard completes your attunement to water spirits and the long journey to earn your Water Totem.
